subject: Reprofile MAP after procurement security gating
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@novamed.com>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Timeline hit — security gating added to MAP

Marcus —

Quick update from our side: Novamed's security team just completed an initial review and they flagged that for PHI workloads they want a VPC/private deployment checklist completed plus a KMS/HSM attestation before legal will sign. This is new gating that wasn't in our original MAP.

Realistically this adds ~3 weeks to our internal acceptance window (they want network diagrams, key rotation policy, and SOC2 evidence). Procurement asked us to formally request a reprofiled close date so they can align budget sign-off.

Can Redwood provide a short-fuse checklist and confirm whether Dedicated or Private will be required for the go-live? We also need a named contact for the security/infra checklist items.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Director, Platform Integrations
Novamed Health

---
Attachments: novamed_soc2_questions.pdf (pdf)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline hit — security gating added to MAP

Thanks for the heads-up, Daniel — really appreciate the clarity.

Short answers up front: yes, we can produce a compact security checklist and an HSM/KMS integration note. Based on what you described, Private (VPC) will be the recommended path for PHI to minimize the compliance lift. That said, Dedicated with strict networking and KMS controls is an option if you prefer a managed infra footprint.

Laura/Priyom — looping you both in to scope the artifact set and propose a reprofiled MAP so Novamed's procurement has something formal to attach to the budget approval. Priyom, can you own a 1-pager (owner + deliverables + deadlines) and a draft updated MAP by EOD?

Daniel — we'll aim to get the 1-pager + updated MAP to you within 24 hours and nominate an infra/security engineer for the checklist. If the procurement team needs an exec sponsor note for the delay, Michael Grant (copied on the internal thread) is available to sign off.

Action items (brief):
- Priyom to produce 1-pager and updated MAP (due: 2028-07-19 10:00 PDT)
- Marcus to introduce infra contact
- Laura to record change in deal timeline and evaluate if a short-term credit/fallback is required

Marcus Lin
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: proposed_map_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 13:00:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Timeline hit — security gating added to MAP

Quick internal sync:

I logged this as a timeline change in the CRM and flagged for procurement review. Priyom, please add a column in the MAP that shows the new acceptance criteria + who is responsible for each artifact (security docs, topology, KMS plan). We need to be explicit so Novamed can route docs to their security reviewers quickly.

On commercial: procurement is likely to request either a brief credit for the slippage window or guaranteed delivery milestones. Michael — do you want to offer a one-time onboarding credit to keep momentum, or would you prefer to preserve pricing and focus on faster artifact delivery? Either way, we should have an internal note prepared for the Novamed exec sponsor.

Also: Priyom, can you attach a short stub of network topology (no secrets) and a HSM/KMS integration note to the MAP version you push? I'll prepare a draft exec note we can sign.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.com>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@novamed.com>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Timeline hit — security gating added to MAP — proposed reprofile and next steps

Daniel / Sara —

Thanks again for the call & detail. Attached is Redwood's proposed reprofiled MAP + a concise security artifact checklist. Summary below:

Proposed timeline (reprofiled):
- 2028-07-18: Security gating identified (this thread)
- 2028-07-19: Redwood delivers 1-pager + updated MAP + topology stub (OWNER: Priyom Das)
- 2028-07-24: Novamed security completes initial review of artifacts (target)
- 2028-07-31: Final acceptance window opens (new go/no-go) — move close by 3 weeks from original contract date

Deliverables (what Redwood will provide):
- Security artifact checklist (network diagram stub, key rotation policy template, KMS/HSM integration note)
- SOC2 evidence summary and pointer to attestations
- Proposed infra pathway (Private VPC recommended; Dedicated alternative documented)
- Single named contact for infra questions: Priyom Das (pri­yom.das@redwood.ai)

Commercial mitigations:
- We understand procurement's need for schedule certainty. Michael has authorized a one-time onboarding credit discussion if Novamed confirms the reprofiled timeline. Laura will follow up with the commercial note.

Next steps (for Novamed):
- Confirm receipt of MAP v2 and artifact set (reply to this thread)
- Share target internal review date if different from 7/24
- If Procurement requires an exec note, please tell us who it should be addressed to and we'll route it.

We'll upload the MAP v2 and artifacts to the shared Drive link and to the CRM record (SALE-8963) so procurement has a single source.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
